scope: Independent read-only validation, no model calls and no corpus writes

w2.interpretation: The 13 exact-nullability mismatches are printed PDF zeros omitted from XML, not conflicting numeric amounts. The 18 EIN+SSN ambiguous associations were intentionally excluded from XML pair validation. The visible PDF extractor independently reads all 56 W2 documents (328 explicitly populated selected boxes).

limits: XML output total tax, derived tax credits, refund/owed amounts and generated schedules are calculation outputs, not extraction labels.
Only 10 US XML outputs contain IRS1040; state XMLs cannot label 50 federal current-year returns.
50 prior 1040 PDFs are tax year 2024; current XMLs are tax year 2025. Never pair their current amounts as extraction truth.
Calendar-year fields can be blank while template revision says 2024. Require explicit supplied case year or score null; do not guess from filename/revision.
PDF absence and XML omission are not proof of zero. The W2 checks preserve null for blank/absent.
Identity uniqueness and labeled PDF box location are required; XML row order cannot establish association.
XML ReturnTs values are fixture metadata; dates before the declared end of the tax period cannot establish a real submission date.
No input PDFs for K-1, 8959, Schedule A, 6251, payment receipts, corrected W-2c, cancellation or duplicate scenarios.

duplicate_byte_summary.recommendation: Preserve case membership; group linked cases together for any future train/eval split and report both cases and distinct document hashes.
